notes: (0,0) is the tail tip. The box sits 14dp (36.75px) above it; tail half-width 10dp.
Box size follows the text: width = textWidth + 2*36.75 (text wraps at 260dp = 682.5px, min 40dp), height = textHeight + 73.5. Corner radius 47.25, stroke 7.875 #F05248.
The shadow is the box offset (+5.25, +10.5) at #3A2A26 18%.
The Kotlin bubble also clamps the box horizontally to stay 12dp inside the screen; drive that with the boxShift input (the tail stays put).

inputs.name: textWidth
inputs.drives: bubble-box/bubble-shadow width and x (centred) and text-bubble wrap width

inputs.name: textHeight
inputs.drives: bubble-box/bubble-shadow height and y (grows upward from the tail)

inputs.name: boxShift
inputs.drives: x offset of bubble-box, bubble-shadow and text-bubble that keeps the box on screen; tail does not move
